verdict.rationale: Sierra's own blog says it uses outcome-based pricing, where you pay only when the software achieves specific outcomes. That covers the core outcome-based element of the story. But nothing in the evidence shows published rates, per-resolution price points, or spend caps and controls, and nothing shows pricing is available without an enterprise quote. Missing for 10: published price list, explicit per-resolution rate, spending caps/controls, evidence that pricing is not quote-based, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, pricing is outcome-based and published — I pay per resolution with caps and controls, not an opaque enterprise quote

citations.quote: you pay only when the software achieves specific, valuable outcomes: outcome-based pricing.
